6Read the blogs. Write İ (İrem), K (Kaan) or C (Ceren).

İrem: I have been learning the violin for two months. Our orchestra practises every Wednesday. So far, I have learnt three short pieces. Right now, I am practising the hardest one.

Kaan: I used to feel shy on stage, but I am getting used to performing. Our drama group has already given two shows. As soon as lessons end, we meet in the school hall.

Ceren: Our class has been collecting books for a month. We have collected ninety books so far. We are sorting them today. I always check that every book is clean.

    I have learnt three pieces.

    We are checking books today.

    I used to be shy on stage.

  5. 5

    I have been practising an instrument for two months.

  6. 6

    Our project started a month ago.

7Read about the charity exhibition. Write T or F and correct the false statements.

Our school is preparing a charity exhibition for next Friday. The students in 7-C are arranging paintings in the hall now. The art club has been working on recycled sculptures for three weeks. So far, the members have finished eight sculptures, but two are still unfinished. Deren has designed the invitation poster. She has never presented a project to visitors before, so she is a little worried. She practises her talk with a friend at lunchtime. The orchestra has already chosen four pieces and has been rehearsing since Monday. Visitors can buy postcards, and the money will buy books for a children’s hospital. Last year, students used to sell only cakes; now they also sell their own artwork. As soon as the exhibition closes, everyone helps tidy the hall.

9Match the questions about Eymen’s trip with his replies. One is extra.

Questions

  1. 1

    Where are you writing from?

  2. 2

    What have you visited so far?

  3. 3

    What are your friends doing now?

  4. 4

    How long have you been exploring?

  5. 5

    How do you feel about the visit?

Replies

  • a) The museum café closes at five.
  • b) I am at the city science museum.
  • c) We have visited the space gallery and the robot room.
  • d) We have been exploring for two hours.
  • e) I feel fascinated and a little tired.
  • f) They are trying a flight simulator.

Extra: a

10Read Eymen’s trip blog. Answer the questions and identify the parts.

(1) Hello from the city science museum! I am Eymen, and this is our class trip.

(2) Our coach left school at 08.30. So far, we have visited the space gallery and the robot room.

(3) At the moment, my friends are trying a flight simulator. Our guide is explaining how planes fly.

(4) We have been exploring for two hours. I am getting used to reading the English information boards.

(5) I feel fascinated and a little tired. I would love to come back and see the energy gallery!
